subject: R-SWAT for manual calibration of SWAT/SWAT+ is now possible

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: R-SWAT for manual calibration of SWAT/SWAT+ is now possible
parts:
Dear all,

R-SWAT is now can be use for interactive manual calibration, meaning that you just drag your parameter values and can show results directly. More information is in the following link

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GxOJv0H-Fo8

and attached is the screenshot of this option
